question: Gale & Cosm avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Gale & Cosm
is owned by
DKSH
, a leading market expansion services provider based in Zurich, Switzerland. DKSH acquired the Italian cosmetic ingredient and specialty chemical manufacturer—known for items like its water-dispersible avocado oil (
Galeavocado® WS
)—in July 2026. Before the acquisition, the company was independently owned and founded in 2000 by Alfredo Radice.
